taylor (Partnerships): Quick win: ZephyrCloud accepted our addon to their Azure Marketplace image — they'll offer Redwood Private as an optional managed component for enterprise tenants :tada:

raj (Sales): Sweet. Any pilot commitments or expected scale?

taylor (Partnerships): 90-day pilot, 40 tenants, opt-in billing; potential move to Dedicated if >100 tenants. Need onboarding docs and a 1-line blurb.

ivy (Partner Success): I'll manage the kickoff. Please send SSO and agent enrollment steps. Also request a private Slack channel with their infra lead @michael.zephyr (external).

omar (Engineering): Enrollment curl we can share:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/enroll -H "Authorization: Bearer <ENROLL_TOKEN>" -d '{"tenant_id":"zephyr-01"}'`

Also note: agent listens on 8443 and requires outbound TLS to api.redwood.ai:443.

marketplace-bot: listing build 2026-09-12T18:02:10Z - validation: PASS

leo (Marketing): I'll draft partner blurb and one-pager. Hold public announcement until pilot metrics stable for 2 weeks.

taylor (Partnerships): Created `#zephyr-redwood` private channel and invited core folks. Next steps: (1) omar: short enroll snippet + SSO notes by tomorrow, (2) ivy: kickoff schedule, (3) leo: blurb draft. Great job team! :rocket:
